text:
pat: Heads-up: noticed quota dashboard showing sudden tenant-level quota burns for tenant t-303. Preview and final both show spike but ledger shows no matching invoice lines. Suspect routing tag misattribution from yesterday's route-priority rollout.

hema: which metric spiked?

pat: per-route token_rate for route=fast_transform jumped x10 for shard-2 between 2026-03-15T22:00Z-22:15Z. But tracebacks show those requests originated from route=legacy_fanout.

ron: hmm could be route-mapper change that collapsed legacy_fanout -> fast_transform alias without updating cost-tagging layer. That would make console attribute tokens to the wrong route and thus wrong quota buckets.

eng-metering-bot: alert: route_tag_mismatch_rate increased 0.0% -> 4.8% on metering-proxy/shard-2 during 2026-03-15T22:00Z-22:20Z.

hema: if console attribution deviates from ledger, ops will see quota burn but invoices won't match. Two fixes: 1) patch the attribution layer to prefer original client_route if aliasing occurred, 2) add a dashboard column showing "source_route_origins" to highlight mixed-origin spikes.

pat: option 2 is lower risk and faster. Can we surface a breakdown by origin_route in the quota dashboard and add a tooltip: "Mixed origin routes detected - check routing policy rollouts."

ron: I'll add a telemetry dimension origin_route and emit origin_route_counts from metering-proxy. Will also open PR to add the dashboard column. Gate the metric under feature-flag `origin_route_emit`.

hema: UX: add a small red hatch on quota rows where origin_route_counts shows >1 significant origin (threshold 10% of tokens). Also add a link to a short runbook: "route aliasing checklist".

pat: owners: ron -> telemetry + PR for dashboard column, hema -> UX badge + runbook link, pat -> postmortem + billing ops comms.

devex-bot: created ticket MTR-1282: origin-route-attribution-breakdown.

eng-metering-bot: note: once `origin_route_emit` flag is enabled, we will backfill 6h of origin_route_counts for sampling-enabled tenants to seed dashboards.

ron: PR #4402 opened with canary deploy to metering-proxy shard-2 at 2026-03-16T03:00Z. Will post canary metrics here.

pat: thanks. If we see quota vs invoice divergence continue after origin metrics are live, we'll schedule an attribution backfill for affected tenants.
